_s26f_api: s26f: 26.1.2 client API members 26.2 renamed, reshaped or dropped while keeping their data (javap -c -p of both releases)

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.saveRepor.basis: 26.1.2 saveReport(File, CrashReport) answered -1 when the report was printed (getSaveFile set) or saved, -2 when it could not be saved; 26.2 saveReport(File, CrashReport, int) is the same body answering the given code in place of -1 (and still -2), its own saveReport(File, CrashReport)V passes -1. 26.2's two-argument form returns void, so the 26.1.2 shape cannot link to it

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.crash(Lne.basis: 26.1.2 crash: System.exit(saveReportAndShutdownSoundManager(mc, dir, report)), which answered saveReport's -1 / -2; 26.2 crash(.., int code) exits with saveReportAndShutdownSoundManager(.., code), code in place of -1 (javap of both)

net/minecraft/server/Bootstrap.getMissin.basis: 26.1.2 getMissingTranslations() checked every registry against Language.getInstance() (read in checkTranslations / checkGameruleTranslations); 26.2 takes the language as an argument and checks the same registries against it

net/minecraft/world/entity/monster/Vex.g.basis: 26.1.2 Vex.getOwner()Mob = EntityReference.get(owner, level, Mob.class); 26.2 Vex.getOwner()LivingEntity = OwnableEntity's EntityReference.get(owner reference, level, LivingEntity.class); 26.2's setOwner still takes a Mob, so the owner is the same Mob

net/minecraft/client/gui/GuiGraphicsExtr.basis: 26.2 widened the translation and the two rotations to JOML's read-only interfaces (Vector3fc / Quaternionfc, which Vector3f / Quaternionf implement); the body is 26.1.2's (javap: the same GuiEntityRenderState from the same arguments)

26.2 skin takes a Model.Simple (its PlayerSkinWidget builds Model.Simple over the PLAYER / PLAYER_SLIM layers where 26.1.2 built PlayerModels); the picture draws the model's root with its render type, kept by a Model.Simple over the PlayerModel's root() and renderType() (rt/CbS26GuiClient.skinModel, one per model)

overrideRenames.basis: 26.2 renamed Overlay.isPauseScreen to isPausing: the same body (iconst_1; ireturn), and 26.2 asks overlay.isPausing() in Gui.isPausing (which Minecraft.runTick asks) where 26.1.2's runTick asked overlay.isPauseScreen(), so a 26.1.2 overlay's override must carry the new name to be asked

net/minecraft/client/particle/ParticleRe.basis: 26.2's ParticleRenderType record gained a shorthand component (SINGLE_QUADS 'SQ', ITEM_PICKUP 'IP', ELDER_GUARDIANS 'EG', NO_RENDER 'NR'); its only reader is ParticleEngine.countParticles, the debug overlay's per-type count label. A 26.1.2 mod's type has no shorthand, so its name stands in as its label; name() and the record's identity are 26.1.2's

net/minecraft/client/gui/components/Play.basis: 26.2's PlayerTabOverlay keeps the Hud where 26.1.2 kept the Gui (javap: same constructor body, field gui -> hud); 26.1.2's Gui members stand on 26.2's Hud (s26b-splits), the Gui's own Hud is gui.hud

net/minecraft/client/gui/Gui.<init>(Lnet.basis: 26.2's Minecraft builds new Gui(this, new Hud(this), gameRenderer.gameRenderState().guiRenderState); 26.1.2's Gui(minecraft) was that Gui and Hud in one (s26b-splits), so a 26.1.2 construction gets a Hud of its own over the game's GUI state

net/minecraft/util/profiling/metrics/Met.basis: 26.2's constructor takes a sampling phase second, otherwise the same fields; 26.2's own create and builder default it to END_TICK, the tick-end sampling 26.1.2 did

_s26f_covers_basis.net/minecraft/client/renderer/GameRender: restored on GameRenderer by mixin/CbS26GameRendererGettersMixin: 26.2 keeps the private final minecraft field the 26.1.2 getter returned
restored on GameRenderer by mixin/CbS26GameRendererGettersMixin: 26.2 keeps the private final globalSettingsUniform field the 26.1.2 getter returned
_s26f_covers_basis.net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.getVersio: restored on Minecraft by mixin/CbS26VersionTypeMixin(+Hooks): 26.1.2's field held GameConfig.game.versionType, stored right after launchedVersion; 26.2's GameData still carries versionType, its Minecraft no longer reads it. 26.1.2's vanilla never called the getter (javap scan of 26.1.2's client classes)
_s26f_covers_basis.net/minecraft/util/thread/BlockableEvent: restored on BlockableEventLoop by mixin/CbS26DelayedCrashMixin: delayedCrash != null over 26.2's kept static supplier. 26.1.2's only vanilla reader, Minecraft.destroy(), is gone from 26.2, so an override no longer steers the shutdown

_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/effect/InstantenousM: 26.2 renamed the class (InstantaneousMobEffect, pkgmoves) and its override isInstantenous -> isInstantaneous (same body: iconst_1; ireturn). pkgmoves keys the rename on MobEffect, which a call naming InstantenousMobEffect does not reach because 26.1.2's InstantenousMobEffect declares the method itself
_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/scores/ReadOnlyScore: 26.2 dropped the static helper and kept formatValue(NumberFormat) and NumberFormat.format(int): the 26.1.2 body (rt/CbS26Team.safeFormatValue)

_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/level/NaturalSpawner: 26.1.2 (state, spawnFriendlies, spawnEnemies, spawnPersistent); 26.2 dropped the friendlies flag and always keeps friendly categories (javap of both: otherwise the same filter over SPAWNING_CATEGORIES, same order). rt/CbS26World asks 26.2 with (enemies, persistent) and drops the friendly categories when 26.1.2's flag was false
_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/item/ItemStack.getDa: 26.1.2: the DAMAGE_TYPE component's source for the attacker, else Item.getItemDamageSource(attacker), else the caller's supplier; 26.2 dropped the supplier and falls back to the attacker's mob-attack source. rt/CbS26Entity.getDamageSource runs the 26.1.2 body over the same 26.2 parts, so the caller's fallback is kept
_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/client/gui/components/tabs: 26.2 moved 26.1.2's menu-bar builder (builder(manager, width), 24 high, a button per tab) to MenuTabBar.builder(manager, width), whose Builder extends TabNavigationBar.Builder; 26.2's CreateWorldScreen / StatsScreen (26.1.2's users) build MenuTabBars (rt/CbS26TabBars)
26.2 MenuTabBar.Builder.addTabs(tabs...) = 26.1.2's addTabs (a 24-high button per tab); a plain 26.2 builder gets MenuTabButtons through addTab(button, tab) (rt/CbS26TabBars)
26.1.2 updateWidth(w) = width = w; arrangeElements(); 26.2 MenuTabBar.arrangeElements(w) is that body (sets width, sizes the buttons min(400, w) - 28 over the tabs, centres the row)
26.1.2 arrangeElements() at the bar's width; 26.2 arrangeElements(width) on the bar's getWidth() (MenuTabBar's override is 26.1.2's body; a plain 26.2 bar positions its frame at getX/getY)

_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/client/gui/Gui.extractSavi: 26.2 Hud.extractSavingIndicator: instruction-identical to 26.1.2's Gui body (javap diff empty), reached as gui.hud
_s26f_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/client/gui/Gui.vignetteBri: 26.2 Hud.vignetteBrightness (public float), set and read by the vignette code that moved to Hud; reached as gui.hud
